target: W06 / P6 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001: review deduplication and audit economy. Introduce ReviewReceiptKey = review_type + head_sha + policy_digest + reviewer_class; a pure reuse decision (REUSE with MODEL_CALLS=0 when an unchanged exact subject has a still-valid qualifying receipt; NEW_CALL only on substantive head movement, policy change, receipt expiry, reviewer invalidation, or explicit authorized rerun); and a lifecycle projection (implement -> validate -> PR -> CI/reviews -> repair -> review settled -> freeze -> one final audit -> finality) that never uses GitHub draft->ready as the sole trigger for an expensive review. Base is the A1-audited W01 head 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875. Ordered after W02 and W04 by MACRO dependency; consumes no sibling code.
invariants: MACRO I18, I20 and section 10 W06 apply. The module is PURE: no filesystem, subprocess, clock, network or model calls; every timestamp is caller-supplied. It imports nothing from dispatch/, environment/, receipts/, freeze/ or join/.

ReviewReceiptKey(review_type, head_sha (git_oid), policy_digest (sha256), reviewer_class) is a frozen dataclass; key digest = sha256 of the four fields joined by newline in that fixed order; equality of keys is equality of digests. review_type and reviewer_class are validated against closed sets defined in the module and asserted by test: review_type in {CI, CODE_REVIEW, SEMANTIC_REVIEW, SECURITY_REVIEW, FINAL_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT}; reviewer_class in {DETERMINISTIC, MODEL_STANDARD, MODEL_PREMIUM, HUMAN}.

decide_review(request: ReviewRequest, existing: Sequence[ReviewReceiptRecord], now: str, policy: ReviewPolicy) -> ReviewDecision with decision in {REUSE, NEW_CALL, BLOCKED} and a reasons tuple (stable order). REUSE requires: an existing record whose key digest equals the request key, whose verdict is in the policy's qualifying set, whose expires_at > now, which is not invalidated, and whose subject_head == request.head_sha. Any of: head_sha differs (substantive head movement), policy_digest differs, expires_at <= now, invalidated is True, or request.explicit_rerun_authorized is True -> NEW_CALL with the specific reason. Missing or malformed inputs -> BLOCKED (fail closed), never REUSE. A REUSE decision carries model_calls_avoided = 1 for MODEL_* reviewer classes and 0 otherwise; a NEW_CALL for a MODEL_PREMIUM class when an unexpired qualifying receipt for the same key exists is impossible by construction (test proves it), satisfying I20.

Triggers are structured, not GitHub-state-derived: ReviewRequest.trigger in {HEAD_MOVED, POLICY_CHANGED, RECEIPT_EXPIRED, REVIEWER_INVALIDATED, EXPLICIT_RERUN, FREEZE_REACHED, SETTLEMENT_REACHED}. A trigger value DRAFT_TO_READY is deliberately NOT a member; a test asserts that constructing a request with it raises and that no code path consults a GitHub draft flag.

Lifecycle projection: LifecycleStage enum in the fixed order IMPLEMENT, VALIDATE, PR, CI_REVIEWS, REPAIR, REVIEW_SETTLED, FREEZE, FINAL_AUDIT, FINALITY; advance(stage, event) is a pure function that only permits: IMPLEMENT->VALIDATE, VALIDATE->PR, PR->CI_REVIEWS, CI_REVIEWS->REPAIR, CI_REVIEWS->REVIEW_SETTLED, REPAIR->VALIDATE, REVIEW_SETTLED->FREEZE, FREEZE->FINAL_AUDIT, FINAL_AUDIT->FINALITY, FINAL_AUDIT->REPAIR (audit FAIL, which also forces the caller to UNFREEZE per W04; this module just projects), and anything else raises IllegalStage. The FINAL_AUDIT stage may be entered at most once per freeze: advance() takes a freeze_ref and refuses a second FINAL_AUDIT entry for the same freeze_ref (test).
Outputs carry authority const NONE and is_execution_authority False; a ReviewDecision is advice to the caller, never a reviewer invocation.
Base commit exactly 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 in worktree .worktrees/gec-v2-w06 branch feat/gec-v2-w06-review-economy-001. Any other base is STOP_WRONG_BASE.

Write surface is exactly commit.allowlist. Forbidden: src/dopemux/governed_execution/__init__.py, tests/unit/governed_execution/__init__.py, sibling prefixes (dispatch/, environment/, receipts/, freeze/, join/), schemas/**, .control-tower/**, pyproject.toml, tests/governance/**.

No model audits; no push; no TO/ConPort/dope-memory/GitHub mutation; no placeholders; ASCII only; ruff clean; frozen dataclasses; type hints; one substantive attempt; semantic ambiguity stops and returns.

pr.body:
## Summary
- W06 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001, stacked on W01
- ReviewReceiptKey (review_type + head_sha + policy_digest + reviewer_class)
- pure reuse decision: REUSE / NEW_CALL / BLOCKED with structured triggers; draft->ready is not a trigger
- lifecycle projection implement -> validate -> PR -> CI/reviews -> repair -> review settled -> freeze -> one final audit -> finality

MERGE_AUTHORIZED=NO ACTIVATION_AUTHORIZED=NO

requirements: Worktree /Users/hue/code/dopemux-mvp/.worktrees/gec-v2-w06, branch feat/gec-v2-w06-review-economy-001, 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 ancestor of HEAD, clean tree except this packet; tests/governance/governed_execution passes (98).

ReviewReceiptKey frozen dataclass with validation of review_type/reviewer_class against the closed sets, git_oid and sha256 pattern checks (ValueError on violation), .digest property per invariant 2; ReviewReceiptRecord(key, verdict, issued_at, expires_at, invalidated: bool, subject_head, receipt_ref {path, sha256}) frozen.

ReviewPolicy(policy_digest, qualifying_verdicts: frozenset[str], premium_classes: frozenset[str]); ReviewRequest(key, trigger, explicit_rerun_authorized: bool); decide_review per invariant 3 returning ReviewDecision(decision, reasons, reused_receipt_ref | None, model_calls_avoided: int, authority 'NONE', is_execution_authority False). Trigger enum per invariant 4 with DRAFT_TO_READY absent and a constructor guard rejecting unknown trigger strings.

LifecycleStage enum and advance(stage, event, freeze_ref, seen_final_audits: frozenset[str]) -> (new_stage, new_seen) per invariant 5; IllegalStage on anything else; second FINAL_AUDIT for the same freeze_ref raises FinalAuditAlreadyConsumed.
test_keys: digest determinism and order sensitivity; each closed-set and pattern rejection; equality via digest.

test_decide: REUSE happy path with model_calls_avoided 1 for MODEL_PREMIUM and 0 for DETERMINISTIC; NEW_CALL for each of the five invalidation reasons with the reason named; BLOCKED for missing key / malformed record / empty policy qualifying set; I20 property test: for any unexpired non-invalidated qualifying record with equal key, decision is never NEW_CALL unless explicit_rerun_authorized; DRAFT_TO_READY construction raises; determinism (same input -> equal output); purity via monkeypatched open/subprocess.run.

test_lifecycle: every legal transition; every illegal pair raises (exhaustive over the enum product); FINAL_AUDIT twice for one freeze_ref raises; REPAIR after FINAL_AUDIT allowed once then requires a new freeze_ref.
Run every commit.verify line; all exit 0. Commit per slice. No push.
